projects.title: Oils
projects.summary: Oil paintings of figures turned away, and the pull between home and the road.
body: I trained as a screenwriter before I painted, and I still think in scenes. A painting, for me, is the moment just before or just after something happens.

I build each picture on the tension between warm and cold, between the calm of home and the urge to leave it. My figures usually turn away. I would rather you stand where they stand than look at their faces.
The work grows one painting at a time, like a diary of looking for a place of my own.

projects.title: All that lies beneath
projects.summary: Co-written with director Jules Roux, based on his subject. Featured at FAMUFEST.
body: Marek sets out into a system of underground tunnels to find his brother, led astray by the war. In bad times, when freedom exists only as a fluttering bird, the brothers ask whether it is still possible to let it out of its cage.
A 25-minute short film, co-written with director Jules Roux and based on his subject. Featured at the FAMUFEST student film festival.

projects.title: Good night, sleep tight
projects.summary: Co-written with director Jules Roux from my original screenplay. Nominated for best film at FAMUFEST.
body: Tomorrow Anna has a very important job interview. If it goes well, big changes are waiting for her. She is just on her way home, where all she wants is to rest and get ready for tomorrow. But…
A 14-minute short film. The script was co-written with director Jules Roux and based on my original screenplay. Nominated for best film at the FAMUFEST student film festival.

projects.title: I want to die as a martyr
projects.summary: Co-written with documentarist Juliana Moska. Produced by FAMU and shown on ČT art.
body: “I just saw a documentary about Syria. They have nice weather there,” says a future Czech jihadist over a family dinner. His remark is only a futile attempt to bring his family closer to the motives that are leading him to join the Islamic State. Inspired by the figure of Jan Silovský, the film follows the dark thoughts of a man determined to leave for Syria.
An 8-minute short film co-written with documentarist Juliana Moska. Produced by FAMU and shot in the studio. Featured as part of a TV show about young filmmakers on ČT art.
